''[[Star Wars: Lethal Alliance]]'' features [[Kyle Katarn]] as an agent of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] so the game should take place after Katarn joined the Alliance, which ''[[Dark Forces: Soldier for the Empire]]'' and ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' date to [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]]. Furthermore, the last part of the game depicted the [[Destruction of Despayre]] and the [[Mission to Danuta]], which ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' dates to [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]]. In conclusion, the fist part of ''Lethal Alliance'' takes place sometime between 1 BBY and 0 BBY, and the second part of the game takes place in 0 BBY.
